Another difference in this v2 release is the usage of a partially uncensored "Part 0" release of segments of episodes 1 and 2. This source was used to fill in some spots where we had to originally use lower quality subtitled Brazilian footage. Also, believe it or not, elgringo provided the original 1984 Japanese VHS release of this episode to us, which contained one uncensored shot that was censored on the "Part 0" source, as well as all LD and DVD masters, which we utilized in this v2 release.

We will release the remaining episodes one at a time, as we are able to put them together.

Want to help restore the footage, provide new sources for us to use and restore, or work on the scripts? Join our Discord server!
